decision: Which loss reasons, segments and competitors cost us the most revenue, and where should the fix start?
limitations: Input it doesn't recognise returns the worked example rather than an error; check the result reflects your data. From the command line it prints the demo even for valid deals.
It computes rates and revenue concentration only. It does not read win reasons, interview notes or the stage a deal was lost at; that work stays with the skill.
The 'biggest fixable leak' is simply the segment and loss reason with the most lost revenue, even no decision or missing feature. Decide yourself whether it is fixable.
It does not flag thin samples. A reason with one or two deals can top the list; check the count beside each before calling it a pattern.
review: The sales lead confirms loss reasons are coded from deal evidence into a consistent set and that each top pattern rests on enough deals, before a fix is assigned to product, marketing or sales.
